title: Crypto Brief — 26 Nov 2026
intro: European trading opens on Thursday with a mixed risk profile as regional markets digest broader macroeconomic headwinds and U.S. trade policy developments. Major indices and equities face pressure from ongoing AI sector rotation, while safe-haven assets such as Gold trade higher at 3,593.40 amid steady safe-haven demand.

sections.heading: Crypto theme
sections.content: Macroeconomic crosswinds and shifting global trade dynamics dominate sentiment today, with the U.S. Dollar Index holding at 103.74 and the U.S. 10-year yield easing 5.6 basis points to 4.848%. Crypto markets continue to consolidate within familiar ranges as institutional flows recalibrate against traditional equity selloffs.

sections.heading: Bitcoin & Ether
sections.content: Bitcoin trades at 60,552, registering a modest 0.29 percent gain on the day despite a 1.0 percent weekly retreat, maintaining a relatively stable consolidation range. Ethereum changes hands at 1,688.88, down 0.11 percent daily and 1.9 percent weekly, resulting in an ETH/BTC ratio of 0.02789.

sections.heading: Altcoins
sections.content: Alternative assets display broad relative strength against Bitcoin, with nine out of ten tracked altcoins outperforming BTC over the weekly timeframe. Litecoin leads the pack with an 8.0 percent weekly gain, while Zcash lags significantly with a 3.36 percent daily drop and a 6.4 percent weekly loss.

sections.heading: Potential scenarios
sections.content:
- *▲ Bullish · Bitcoin — above 61,150 opens 63,200 · invalid below 59,500*
A sustained push above local resistance could attract fresh spot accumulation and drive prices toward higher weekly liquidity bands.
- *▼ Bearish · Ethereum — below 1,660.00 opens 1,590.00 · invalid above 1,720.00*
Persistent macro pressures and a weak ETH/BTC ratio risk dragging the asset lower toward key support levels.
- *▲ Bullish · Litecoin — above 44.00 opens 46.50 · invalid below 42.00*
Strong relative momentum over the past week positions the asset to continue outperforming broader large-cap peers.

sections.heading: Key risks
sections.content:
- Escalating trade tensions following new U.S. tariff proposals targeting major global trading partners.
- Spillover effects from the broader AI tech equity selloff impacting broader risk sentiment.
